title: Define inspection and loading fields
description: Define one production contract for plain-paper inspection, loading, and observation-entry fields so domain validation and accessible UI use identical required, diagnostic, and optional classifications.
acceptanceCriteria: Each field has a stable ID, classification, type, unit where applicable, constraints, and help text
Domain and UI derive required, diagnostic, and optional behavior from one contract
Asymmetric loading guidance is textual and tied to exact setup/loading/configuration assumptions
Invalid numeric, unit, or missing required values return field-associated reasons

steps.details: Translate PRD 25 inspection, loading, sample, measurement, and assumption needs into stable field definitions without prototype-only gates.
Specify classification, value type, allowed units, finite numeric constraints, accessible instructions, and diagnostic purpose.
Return normalized values or structured field reasons from one pure validator consumed by domain and forms.
Verify UI-required indicators and domain validation agree for complete, missing, malformed, non-finite, and unsupported-unit fixtures.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; define and test the field registry only.
Required entry fields are not evidence-sufficiency thresholds.
